verdict.rationale: The Mesh docs state that API credentials are generated under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date. Endpoint reference pages name specific permissions (e.g. "Monitor and unmonitor customers", "View roles in account"), which shows fine-grained scoping is possible for an agent's credential. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the credential permission model and its granularity, credential rotation/revocation workflow, agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
